mechanism_narrative: A increase in GDP growth rate signals a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive GDP growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to higher wages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with low unemployment, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive housing starts and low unemployment, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with positive industrial production, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply signal an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low federal funds rate and high money supply, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with high payroll employment, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index signals a decrease in inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with low consumer price index, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.
